# Christmas Lights Over Columbus

> Premier residential and commercial holiday lighting and permanent smart architectural lighting contractor based in Columbus, Ohio. Specializing in custom Christmas light installation, commercial displays, permanent roofline lighting, landscape & tree wrapping, maintenance, takedown, and secure storage. Fully licensed and insured with commercial-grade LED lighting systems.

Christmas Lights Over Columbus serves homeowners and businesses throughout the greater Columbus, Ohio metropolitan area and Central Ohio communities, including Franklin, Delaware, Union, and Fairfield Counties (Dublin, Upper Arlington, Powell, New Albany, Bexley, Worthington, Westerville, Hilliard, Grandview Heights, Pickerington, and surrounding areas).

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://lightsovercolumbus.com/services): Complete holiday and architectural lighting solutions
- [Residential Holiday Lighting](https://lightsovercolumbus.com/services/residential-lighting): Custom-fitted roofline C9 LEDs, landscape lighting, and wreaths
- [Commercial Holiday Lighting](https://lightsovercolumbus.com/services/commercial-lighting): Large-scale holiday displays for storefronts, shopping centers, and offices
- [Permanent Smart Lighting](https://lightsovercolumbus.com/services/permanent-lighting): Year-round app-controlled architectural lighting for rooflines and patios
- [Tree & Landscape Wrapping](https://lightsovercolumbus.com/services/tree-wrapping): Precision trunk wrapping, canopy illumination, and shrub lighting
